additional_info.body:
Hello Leeron, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the connection remotely and I can find that sometimes the connection is not stable:
As you can see, there are 3 connection variables that are fair to poor and no signal. From our side, the OCPP connection is there, as Orel already showed you:
From our side, it's clear that everything is running as it should in terms of hardware.
If there is any change to be done, I would recommend other SIM cards until you find one with good coverage and check if the plan is good.
Since there is nothing else for us to provide, we will close the ticket.
Feel free to reach out to Orel for this topic.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
